an7.55:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] satta ca bhikkhave purisagatiyo desissāmi anupādā ca parinibbānaṃ.
an7.55:1.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.55:2.1: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
an7.55:2.2: no cassa, no ca me siyā. na bhavissati, na ca me bhavissati. yadatthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti upekkhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an7.55:2.3: so bhave na rajjati. sambhave na rajjati. atthuttariṃ padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
an7.55:2.4: tañca khvāssa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti. tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti.
an7.55:2.5: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarā parinibbāyī hoti.
an7.55:2.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, divasasantatte ayokapāle haññamāne papaṭikā nibbattitvā nibbāyeyya, -
an7.55:2.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
an7.55:2.8: no cassa, no ca me siyā. na bhavissati, na me bhavissati. yadatthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti upekkhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an7.55:2.9: so bhave na rajjati. sambhave na rajjati. atthuttariṃ padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
an7.55:2.10: tañca khvāssa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti. tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti.
an7.55:2.11: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarā- parinibbāyī hoti.

an7.55:6.8: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. (6)

an7.55:7.3: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṅkhāra parinibbāyī hoti.
an7.55:7.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, divasasantatte ayokapāle haññamāne papaṭikā nibbattitvā uppatitvā vipule tiṇapuñje vā kaṭṭhapuñje vā nipateyya,
an7.55:7.5: sā tattha aggimpi janeyya, dhūmampi janeyya, aggimpi janetvā dhūmampi janetvā tameva vipulaṃ tiṇapuñjaṃ vā kaṭṭhapuñjaṃ vā pariyādiyitvā anāhārā nibbāyeyya, -
an7.55:7.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti;
an7.55:7.7: no cassa, no ca me siyā …pe…

an7.55:8.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
an7.55:8.2: no cassa, no ca me siyā. na bhavissati, na me bhavissati. yadatthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti upekkhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an7.55:8.3: so bhave na rajjati. sambhave na rajjati. atthuttariṃ padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
an7.55:8.4: tañca khvāssa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti. tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti. na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti.
an7.55:8.5: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
an7.55:8.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, divasasantatte ayokapāle haññamāne papaṭikā nibbattitvā uppatitvā mahante tiṇapuñje vā kaṭṭhapuñje vā nipateyya,
an7.55:8.7: sā tattha aggimpi janeyya, dhūmampi janeyya, aggimpi janetvā dhūmampi janetvā tameva mahantaṃ tiṇapuñjaṃ vā kaṭṭhapuñjaṃ vā pariyādiyitvā kacchampi daheyya, dāyampi daheyya, kacchampi dahitvā dāyampi dahitvā haritantaṃ vā patthantaṃ vā selantaṃ vā udakantaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyeyya, -
an7.55:8.8: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
an7.55:8.9: no cassa, no ca me siyā …pe…
an7.55:8.10: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā uddhaṃ soto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
an7.55:9.2: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:

an7.55:9.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… (cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ) sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
